classes.name: TNF inhibitors
classes.description: Adalimumab and biosimilars (Humira, Hadlima, Hyrimoz, Cyltezo, Yusimry, Simlandi, Amjevita, unbranded adalimumab-adaz/-fkjp/-aacf), etanercept (Enbrel, Erelzi, Eticovo), certolizumab (Cimzia), golimumab (Simponi). Infliximab is infusion/medical benefit.

classes.indication: RA, PsA, AS, psoriasis, Crohn's, UC

classes.name: IL-17 and IL-23 inhibitors
classes.description: Secukinumab (Cosentyx), ixekizumab (Taltz), bimekizumab (Bimzelx), brodalumab (Siliq); guselkumab (Tremfya), risankizumab (Skyrizi), tildrakizumab (Ilumya), ustekinumab and biosimilars (Stelara, Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Otulfi, Imuldosa, Yesintek, Steqeyma).
classes.plainDescription: A shot for psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis or Crohn's/colitis.

classes.name: Oral JAK inhibitors
classes.description: Tofacitinib (Xeljanz, XR), upadacitinib (Rinvoq), baricitinib (Olumiant) for RA/PsA/UC; deucravacitinib (Sotyktu, TYK2) for psoriasis; apremilast (Otezla, PDE4) as an oral psoriasis alternative.
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis or colitis.

records.verificationNote: Read from PDL p.55 (Immunomodulators: TNF Inhibitors). Pick: unbranded adalimumab-adaz, a biosimilar, not an AB-rated generic, so genericAvailable is false; it is the preferred TNF product with PA. records.verificationNote: Otulfi 45 mg/0.5 mL syringe read on page 72: Tier 3 (Preferred Brand), PA and QL 1.5 per 84 days. No IL-17 or IL-23 agent in this class is listed without PA. Otulfi is a ustekinumab biosimilar, the lowest tier in the class. The pick is a judgment call: the 45 mg strength is the lowest-tier listed product. Brodalumab (Siliq), bimekizumab (Bimzelx), ixekizumab (Taltz), tildrakizumab (Ilumya) and the other ustekinumab biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Pyzchiva, Imuldosa, Steqeyma) are not listed. Omlyclo (omalizumab) appears on page 72 but is outside this class. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-read by x-coordinate on v17 pages 70-74. Adjudicated: Otulfi and Yesintek are both Tier 3 (Preferred Brand) with PA and QL 1.5 per 84 days for the 45 mg dose, so Otulfi is one of two equal picks, not the sole preferred product; Stelara and unbranded ustekinumab are Tier 5. Ustekinumab blocks IL-12/23 (the class definition includes it); Cosentyx, Tremfya and Skyrizi, the IL-17 and IL-23 agents, are all Tier 5 with PA, so the ustekinumab biosimilar is the lowest-barrier product.] [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary (exported 2026-11-02)] [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary (reused, checked)] [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary (reused, checked)]
